title: Motor population co-smoothing
disposition_reason: Current source grades complete 574-trial co-smoothing predictions and contains full operator/programme and per-case investigation source. It needs externally authenticated inputs and qualified deployment; condition-assisted success alone does not identify incremental neural information.

scientific_target.question: How well do 137 observed motor-cortex units predict the 45 unobserved units on 574 held-out development trials, beyond permitted movement-condition and time context?
scientific_target.known_answer: Observed withheld-unit integer spike counts on the fixed 140-bin 5 ms support; predictions are positive expected counts, not recovered true latent firing rates.
scientific_target.answer_origin: MC_Maze NWB spikes from Jenkins 2009-09-25; withheld unit axis and evaluation support are private scorer inputs.
scientific_target.case_unit: One whole reach trial;574 nested prediction cases within one session.
scientific_target.independent_unit: One macaque, Jenkins, in one session; trials/neurons/condition repetitions are not independent animals.
scientific_target.inference_scope: Retrospective within-session, condition-assisted prediction of measured spikes; signed matched-condition controls can test incremental observation use.
exclusions: Identification of biological latent states from prediction scores.
Generalization to new animals or contamination-resistant final evaluation.

inputs: 1721 training trials with 137 observed+45 withheld spike-count units;574 query trials with only 137 observed units.
Complete 140×5 ms neural window per trial, permitted condition IDs, explicit unit/trial axes and fixed valid-support mask.
forbidden_inputs: Query withheld spike counts, raw target-bearing NWB, reference prediction arrays and private scores.
Kinematic targets or source identities usable for answer lookup.
observation_contract.case_identity: Exact opaque eval_trial_ids and heldout_unit_ids from the authenticated public packet; scorer aligns permutations by IDs and checks panel_fingerprint. Actual identities are not distributed in this source checkout.
observation_contract.split: Declared 1721 training/574 development whole-trial split of one Jenkins session; supervised selection stays inside whole training trials. Conditions have training support, so this is not held-out-condition transfer.
observation_contract.coverage: Every 574×140×45 output cell required. Complete operator source retains 100 mode/context/code/seed groups and all 574 cases per group; these are conditions/repeats, not 100 new benchmarks. Public targets, including former NLB test targets, remain exposed development material.

primary.name: pooled_poisson_co_smoothing_bits_per_spike
primary.aggregation: Sum Poisson log-likelihood improvement over all fixed valid trial/bin/withheld-unit cells, divided by observed spikes and ln 2.
primary.rationale: Scores held-out measured spikes; evaluation-target per-unit mean is a private normalization, distinct from a deployable comparator.

secondary: Signed co-bps difference versus frozen training-only condition/time predictor.
Condition-wise and whole-trial error summaries; intact versus within-condition-shuffled and context-only inputs.

comparators.name: training_condition_time
comparators.inputs: Training withheld counts and permitted trial-condition/time context only.
comparators.procedure: Implemented fixed training profiles shrunk by one pseudo-trial toward smoothed global rate;60-bin Gaussian sigma 10; no query-neural input.

comparators.name: matched_input_controls
comparators.inputs: Same training source plus intact, within-condition-shuffled, context-only, training-rate-only or metadata-neutral query projection.
comparators.procedure: Implemented source projections; freeze shuffle and fit/adaptation per condition before scores. Actual complete matched execution remains unqualified.

nuisance_controls: Hold trial identity and conditions fixed when shuffling neural observations.
Whole trials stay together in selection; no target-dependent missingness.
Compare neural gain against condition/time structure, not only global rate.
evaluation.uncertainty: Report descriptive paired whole-trial/condition blocks within one session; no animal-population interval from 574 trials or 45 units.
evaluation.failure_policy: Require all expected IDs/units/time bins and finite strictly positive expected_spikes_per_bin. Invalid/missing responses receive failure with no favorable subset. All-zero target spike total is explicitly undefined; negative scores remain valid.

implementation.scorer_target: Strictly positive expected withheld-neuron spike counts against observed counts; arbitrary compliant predictions accepted, with no source-table or reference-equality requirement.
implementation.delivered_scope: Complete numeric scorer and full operator/investigation source for the named exposed development panel; no bundled authentic arrays or qualified Linux deployment.
missing: Authenticate exact public/private input packet and native conversion.
Qualify full operator runtime, model transport and external review/custody requirements.
Execute matched neural-dependence controls before interpreting co-bps as information beyond condition context.
implementation.execution_evidence: Manifest preserves historical finite local prediction-scoring/fixed-programme checks but explicitly does not transfer qualification to current source. Source inspection here is not a new model trial.

direct_observation.representation: Proposed per-trial numerical counts or fixed raster with all 140×45 positive withheld-unit expected counts; no no-tools participant transport is supplied.
direct_observation.boundary: Any future direct arm must receive exactly the selected permitted observation and calibrated units, with no decoder, Python, source lookup, target or score access.
missing: Freeze a feasible complete per-case observation and response representation without silently changing the target.
Deliver and qualify a no-tools transport and complete answer collector before a direct-understanding claim.

typed_viewer.representation: Proposed typed raster/time-window inspection of the same selected neural observations; no viewer is delivered for this registration.
typed_viewer.boundary: Only admitted rendered views; raw numerical/model operations would belong to the tool-assisted condition. Query targets and source identities remain inaccessible.
missing: Implement task-specific renderer, restricted actions and complete responses.
Verify rendered observations preserve required time/unit information and run a separately identified viewer evaluation.

tool_assisted.representation: Per-case numerical/model investigation of the complete permitted neural packet.
tool_assisted.boundary: Match observations, calibration, decoder access and cumulative compute against the fixed programme; freeze shared preparation, reset case state and prevent target/score feedback.

frozen_program.representation: Precommitted executable and fitting recipe; training precedes query prediction.
frozen_program.boundary: Freeze source, fitting, selection and permitted query adaptation before assessment access; authentic target custody and runtime qualification remain external.
missing: Qualify the actual external data/runtime source closure and complete programme execution.
